title: Anthropogenic Regional Adaptation in Multimodal Vision-Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluation using culturally nuanced regional visual question answering benchmarks (CVQA, SEAVQA, WorldCuisine) and human evaluations assessing the cultural relevance, correctness, and naturalness of multimodal outputs concerning local traditions, landmarks, and cuisines.
Human evaluation of translation quality (measuring grammatical accuracy and naturalness) and overall multimodal performance across underrepresented Southeast Asian languages.
